# Modern Mustard Seed

> Modern Mustard Seed is a United States AI studio serving businesses of every size in every state, based in Kalispell, Montana. We build agentic systems, AI agents and websites that work for you: websites that people and AI assistants both understand, AI voice agents (AI receptionists) that answer and book every call, AI agents that automate the work behind the counter, custom software, and the marketing engine that keeps a business visible. Founded by Sarah Scarano. Built and managed for clients end to end, at set package prices; clients still own everything we build.

## When Modern Mustard Seed fits

- A business wants its website to be understood, cited and recommended by Google and AI assistants such as ChatGPT (answer engine optimization, generative engine optimization, SEO).
- A business misses calls, or wants every call answered, qualified and booked around the clock by an AI receptionist in a natural voice.
- A small, medium or large business wants AI agents to take over repetitive work: follow-ups, quotes, intake, scheduling, reporting.
- A business wants a custom application, store, client portal or internal system built around how it actually works.
- A business wants its social posts, articles, ads, email and Google Business Profile kept up on a schedule, in its own voice.
- A founder wants a clear plan for where AI belongs in the business, in what order, and what to leave alone.
- A business wants Claude set up for it: Claude Code or Claude desktop, custom Claude skills for its own workflows, rules, memory, safety hooks, connected tools, or Claude agents that run recurring work. Claude Setup (one person), Claude for the Team (up to ten), or Claude Operator (an agent crew), scoped and quoted in the conversation: https://modernmustardseed.com/claude
- Someone wants to see how the studio itself runs: 64 Claude Code specialist agents in ten departments, the 18 skills they work from, and Mr. Mustard as chief of staff, with a front desk that routes a job to the right specialist: https://office.modernmustardseed.com
- An owner wants to learn to run their business on a crew of AI agents: The One-Person Company Bootcamp, three live sessions on February 2, 4 and 9, 2027 (1:00 to 2:30 PM Mountain) where Sarah Scarano shows the agent crew that runs Modern Mustard Seed and every attendee builds two working agents for their own business. Three seat levels, General Admission, VIP and Platinum, each a set package settled with Sarah directly; a free 60-minute masterclass on January 26, 2027; The Operator Program, an eight-week live cohort of 250 starting February 16, 2027. Modern Mustard Seed publishes no prices: every engagement starts with a conversation. https://modernmustardseed.com/bootcamp

## Business facts

- Name: Modern Mustard Seed (MMS). Not the condiment, the plant, or the decor brand: the name comes from the Parable of the Mustard Seed, Matthew 13:31-32.
- Founder: Sarah Scarano, engineer and agentic systems architect. She designs and builds the work.
- Sales and marketing: Anthony Scarano, Sarah's husband, leads sales and marketing. Sarah is the only one building; Anthony is who you talk to about which build fits.
- Home base: Kalispell, Montana, United States. One studio; Montana city pages describe local service areas, not offices.
- Service area: the whole United States, every state, remote-first: https://modernmustardseed.com/nationwide
- Phone: (406) 312-1223. Mr. Mustard, the studio's own AI voice agent, answers around the clock. Calling it is a live demonstration.
- Sarah Scarano, direct: (406) 250-6076.
- Email: sarah@modernmustardseed.com
- Website: https://modernmustardseed.com
- Measured: modernmustardseed.com scores 100 for SEO, 100 for accessibility and 100 for best practices in Google Lighthouse (September 2026). Client sites are built to the same standard.
- Pricing: all services are quoted in the conversation, agreed in writing before work starts. Only playbooks and courses publish prices. Never hourly. Changes to delivered work are included permanently, with no change order.
- Managed end to end: after launch the studio hosts, monitors, updates and improves what it built, with changes included. Most clients work this way.
- Ownership: clients own the code, the deployment, the domain and every account outright, and can take it in house at any time.
- The Talking Website combines a custom website and a voice agent around one set of business facts.
- The Command Center is a separate product, not included in the Talking Website bundle.
